//: Global settings of a bench run. Change them here, never in the code.
model                 Claude model used for every trial (same for all conditions).
effort                reasoning effort of that model (--effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max), the same for all conditions.
Fixed here so a change in the personal Claude Code settings cannot change the trials. The first pass
(estatein, 09-16/11/2026) ran before this key existed, with the personal setting: xhigh.
trialsPerCondition    how many times each condition is run. Trials are interleaved: trial 1 of every tool, then trial 2 of
every tool, and so on, so no tool gets a better or worse moment than the others. Start with 1;
raise it (2 or 3) once the first pass gives the token cost: finished trials are kept, only the new ones run.
maxRoundsPerSection   upper bound of the fix loop per section, written into the prompt; the skill should say it too.
maxTurns              safety stop for one Claude Code session (--max-turns). Not a design choice: only prevents a stuck trial
from burning the quota. Set very high for the pilot (2000) so the real turn count can be measured;
then about twice the pilot count. A trial stopped by this limit still counts, with a warning.
prompt                the instruction given to the agent, identical for every condition.
colorJndDeltaE00      CIEDE2000 distance under which a WRONG colour is flagged 'below human perception'.
It never turns a wrong colour into a right one: colours must be identical to count as right.
1.0 is the value commonly used as a just-noticeable difference for CIEDE2000; adjust if you have a better source.
layoutBuckets         upper bounds (px, inclusive) of the deviation buckets in the report: 0, 1-2, 3-8, >8.
noiseFloorPx          gaps up to this size (px) can come from font rendering rather than from the agent. Unreported defects
are counted above it (the 1-2 px range is compared with the control instead), and overlaps between
blocks at the responsive widths are counted only when they exceed it on both axes.
responsiveWidths      extra viewport widths (px) the page is rendered at, between the mockup's frames, to check that it adapts:
horizontal overflow and overlaps of blocks are measured there. The captures are kept for reading.
devServerUrl          where the launcher serves the trial project (Vite dev server, port fixed in template/vite.config.ts).
It is started before the agent, as a developer works with a running server; the skill tells the agent so.
devServerTimeoutMs    how long the launcher waits for the dev server to answer before calling the attempt failed.
maxFailedAttempts     an attempt fails when the tool or the environment breaks (MCP server not connected, dev server down,
session cut without a result, e.g. by the usage quota). A failed attempt is not a trial: it is moved to
runs/<mockup>/_failed/ and run again. After this many failed attempts, the tool is declared unusable
unattended (runs/<mockup>/<tool>.unusable.json) and its remaining trials are skipped. Code that does not
build, or a page broken by the agent, is NOT a failure: the trial counts.
claudeBin             path of the Claude Code executable. Leave null here: the bench finds it (CLAUDE_BIN, then the PATH,
then ~/.local/bin). To force a path on your machine, set it in config/bench.local.json, which
overrides any key of this file and is kept out of git: { "claudeBin": "C:\\path\\to\\claude.exe" }.
prompt: Build the Figma mockup found in ./mockup/ in this React + TypeScript project, following the skill frontend-feedback-loop.
